voice.name: Open Sector - Nebelwerfer
voice.description: Wiry young male rocket artillery gunner in his mid twenties, high-energy and manic, slightly raspy tenor voice, talks fast and giggles at explosions, a gleeful pyromaniac who loves big booms, shouting happily over a truck radio with a light Central European accent.
voice.sample: Oh, oh, oh, look at that! Twelve tubes, one second, boom boom boom! Did you hear them scream? Beautiful! Give me another target, please, I want to see the sky light up again!

fire.prompt: Terrifying salvo of a World War 2 Nebelwerfer rocket launcher firing in an open field: six rockets launch one after another with a roaring whoosh, each shrieking and wailing like a scream as it climbs away into the distance.

move.prompt: WWII military truck diesel engine revving and pulling away, rattling rocket tubes on the back, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Rocket truck explodes, main blast followed by several rockets cooking off with whistles and popping secondary explosions, medium distance, no music, no voice
